verified.notes: Engine Ventures is a separate investment firm that spun out from The Engine (a nonprofit incubator/accelerator founded by MIT in 2016) in 2023. Wikipedia lists Emily Knight as CEO/President of The Engine (not Engine Ventures specifically).

changesProposed.name: Y Combinator

verified.name: Y Combinator
verified.thesis: Y Combinator invests $500,000 per company ($125,000 for 7% equity on post-money SAFE and $375,000 on uncapped SAFE with MFN clause) in a select group of startups accepted into four annual batches. The three-month intensive program in San Francisco provides office hours, mentorship, and community access to help startups improve their product, user base, and fundraising options.
verified.notes: Garry Tan became President & CEO in January 2023 (source 2). Jared Friedman became Managing Partner in March 2024, succeeding Michael Seibel (source 2). Headquarters relocated from Mountain View to San Francisco in spring 2023 (source 2). No explicit sector focus areas found on firm website or Wikipedia sources provided.
